fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-09-29, the relative of the complainant, Senthil Rajan, aged 23, left for a temple visit and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Alli Park Shopping Complex in Salem. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-09-26 at roughly 21:20. The complaint was lodged by Logesh Palanisamy (9000000171), a family member of Senthil Rajan, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000019. Karthik Velan (9000000188), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. Anitha Raman (9000000267) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant could not identify the person involved. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, night, shopping complex, associate, witness
